desc:
Guide the Superhero

How to Play:
🖌️ Draw paths to bring the superheroes home safely!
🚨 Don't let the heroes crash into each other, or the mission fails!
🕷️ Avoid Venom, he's hunting your heroes!
⭐ Collect the stars

Guide Spider-Man, Iron Man, Hulk, Superman and Batman to their homes. This game might sound easy, but its puzzles can get a little tricky!

💾 Progress is saved, your levels save when you leave!
💻 Supports Desktop, Mobile and Tablet players

👍 If you love the game, make sure to like and favorite.
